g.aria-label: - Node 18 is no longer supported; Node 20 or newer is now required.
g.title: - Node 18 is no longer supported; Node 20 or newer is now required.

g.aria-label: - New `--watch` mode regenerates release notes whenever the repository changes.
g.title: - New `--watch` mode regenerates release notes whenever the repository changes.

g.aria-label: - Large diffs are now streamed in chunks instead of being buffered entirely in memory.
g.title: - Large diffs are now streamed in chunks instead of being buffered entirely in memory.

g.aria-label: - Expired tokens are now rejected with a 401 authentication error instead of failing with a server error.
g.title: - Expired tokens are now rejected with a 401 authentication error instead of failing with a server error.

g.aria-label: - An empty commit range no longer crashes; it returns an empty result you can check.
g.title: - An empty commit range no longer crashes; it returns an empty result you can check.

g.aria-label: - The parsed config is cached after the first read, cutting startup time by roughly 3x.
g.title: - The parsed config is cached after the first read, cutting startup time by roughly 3x.

g.aria-label: - Added a README with a quickstart example showing a tag-to-`HEAD` run.
g.title: - Added a README with a quickstart example showing a tag-to-`HEAD` run.

g.text: From raw commits to a changelog
